description: Regulatory PLD limits set by ANEEL, in R$/MWh, per year in force. Used only to ESTIMATE the PLD from the ONS CMO (vw_pld_estimado_*); they do not replace the official CCEE series.
validation: Each cap is the previous year's cap adjusted by IPCA inflation, with the same percentage for the hourly and structural caps (2022→2023: +5.90%; 2023→2024: +4.68%; 2024→2025: +4.87%; 2025→2026: +4.46%). This chaining was used to choose between conflicting values published in the press.

limits.fonte: MegaWhat (minimum and structural); CPFL Soluções (hourly). Hourly value conflicts in the press (1,141.85 is the REN 858/2019 base value, at 2019 prices); 1,197.87 is the one consistent with the 2022 adjustment
MegaWhat, citing an order in the DOU of 2021-12-17. Stima Energia published 640.50 and 1,314.02, inconsistent with the 2023 adjustment
ANEEL ratifying resolution (process 48500.006275/2023-47); replaces the values announced earlier (678.29 and 1,391.56)
ANEEL DSP 3.850/2025, via Canal Solar e Cenário Energia
